app.name: FontCarver
app.tagline: A workshop for outline, bitmap and variable fonts.

reason.noFontTab: The active tab is not a Font tab
reason.noGlyphTab: The active tab is not a Glyph tab
reason.noGlyphLayer: The Edit tab has no layer loaded
reason.noJoin: Select the open ends of two contours
reason.noBreak: Select an on-curve node to open the contour

palette.title: Commands
palette.hint: ↑↓ to navigate · Enter to run · Esc to close

problems.title: Find problems
problems.help: Check outlines, metrics, Unicode, components, kerning and feature rules. Open a glyph to inspect an issue; no repairs are applied automatically.
problems.stale: The document changed. Refresh to check the current version.
problems.wrongDocument: This report belongs to a different document. Reopen Find problems for the active font.
problems.truncated: More problems were found. Showing {{shown, number}} of at least {{total, number}}; increase the result limit to see more (up to 2,000).
problems.featureDiagnostic: Feature rules need attention. See Details for the compiler's message.

code.invalid-upem: Units per em is outside the supported range.
code.nonfinite-metrics: A font or master metric is not a finite number.
code.missing-layer-master: This layer refers to a master that does not exist.
code.invalid-vertical-width: The vertical advance width is invalid.
code.nonfinite-anchor: An anchor position is not a finite number.
code.malformed-contour: The contour's point sequence cannot form a valid outline.
code.nonfinite-point: An outline point is not a finite number.
code.nonfinite-component: A component transform contains a nonfinite value.
code.missing-component: A component refers to a glyph that does not exist.
code.missing-component-layer: A component has no matching layer in this master.
code.component-expansion-limit: Expanded component geometry exceeds the compilation validation limit. See Details for the affected limit.
code.component-depth-limit: Component references exceed the supported nesting depth of 64.
code.invalid-unicode: A Unicode assignment is not a valid scalar value.
code.duplicate-unicode: The same Unicode value is assigned to multiple glyphs.
code.invalid-variation-selector: A Unicode variation sequence is invalid.
code.missing-master-layer: The glyph is missing a layer for one of the font's masters.
code.missing-group-member: A kerning group contains a glyph that does not exist.
code.duplicate-group-membership: A glyph belongs to multiple kerning groups on the same side.
code.inconsistent-group-membership: Glyph and group kerning membership disagree.
code.invalid-kerning-value: A kerning value is not a finite number.
code.invalid-kerning-group: A kerning group has an invalid name or side prefix.
code.missing-kerning-glyph: A kerning pair refers to a glyph that does not exist.
code.missing-kerning-group: A kerning pair refers to a group that does not exist.
code.unapplied-feature-draft: Feature rules have unapplied changes. Apply or discard the draft before exporting.
code.stale-generated-features: The glyph set changed after automatic features were generated. Review and compile the feature source again.
code.feature-validation-skipped: Fix structural errors, then check again to validate feature compilation.

open.title: Open Font
open.label: File path
open.hint: Browser mode has no native file dialog: type a path the kernel can read.
open.formats: Open FCF, TTF, OTF, TTC/OTC, WOFF/WOFF2, UFO, Designspace, Glyphs, SFD or Type 1 (PFA/PFB).

saveAs.title: Save As
saveAs.label: Document path
saveAs.hint: FontCarver documents are saved as .fcf or .fcf.gz.

newFont.title: New Font
newFont.starterHint: Starter glyphs are created empty; the recipe is the same one the Add Glyphs dialog uses.

presetHint.latin: Ascender 80 %, descender −20 %, x-height 50 % and cap height 70 % of the em.
presetHint.cjk: A 1000-unit em with ascender 880 and descender −120.

addGlyphs.title: Add Glyphs
addGlyphs.recipeHint: Ranges (A-Z, U+0041-U+005A), single names (Aacute, a.sc, f_i) and legacy repertoires (@charset:GB2312), separated by spaces or commas.
addGlyphs.empty: Nothing to add yet — type a recipe or choose a character set.
addGlyphs.countFailed: The kernel could not resolve this character set.

export.title: Export
export.pathHint: Browser mode has no native file dialog: type a path the kernel can write.
export.directoryHint: This format writes a package directory, not a single file.
export.cffHint: Static OpenType font with cubic CFF outlines. CFF outlines are exported without hinting; TrueType instructions cannot be retained.
export.type1Hint: Type 1 cannot preserve OpenType layout (kerning, ligatures and substitutions), anchors, source layers or retained hints. Only the selected master is exported, with components expanded into outlines. Unicode assignments may not survive a roundtrip.

option.removeOverlapHint: Merge overlapping contours before the outlines are compiled.
option.keepTtInstructionsHint: Reuse the imported hinting for glyphs that were not edited.
option.preserveUntouchedTablesHint: Copy imported tables the editor did not rewrite into the output.
option.productionNamesHint: Write the production glyph names the model supplies instead of the working names.

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.autosaveHint: Seconds between crash-recovery snapshots; zero turns autosave off.
prefs.nudgeHint: Font units an arrow key moves the selection, plain, with Shift and with the command modifier.
prefs.gridHint: Editing grid in font units; zero turns the grid off.

recovery.title: Recover Documents
recovery.intro: FontCarver found unsaved work from an earlier session.

simplify.title: Simplify
simplify.errorHint: Font units the refitted outline may deviate by.
simplify.forceLines: Curves close to lines become lines
simplify.nearlyHvLines: Straighten nearly horizontal and vertical lines

sidebar.title: Filters
sidebar.empty: Open a font to see its glyph filters.
sidebar.glyphNote: Glyph filters apply to the Font tab; switch to it to change the glyph list.
sidebar.fontInfoNote: Font Info has no filters; switch to the Font tab to filter glyphs.

inspector.title: Inspector
inspector.fontInfoNote: Font Info is read-only in this release; editing arrives with the next phase.

toast.copyFailed: Could not write to the clipboard

errors.not_found: That item is not in the document any more
errors.invalid_params: The kernel rejected the request as invalid
errors.io: A file could not be read or written
errors.parse: The font data could not be read
errors.internal: The kernel hit an internal error
errors.export: The font could not be exported
errors.shaping: The layout features could not be compiled
errors.invalid_response: The kernel returned an unexpected response
errors.timeout: The kernel did not answer in time
errors.transport: The interface could not reach the kernel
errors.kerning_unavailable: Kerning cannot be edited for this font yet.
errors.stale_generation: The document changed. Refresh the data and try again.
errors.stale_problems: The document changed during the scan. Refresh to check the current version.

warning.cffUnhintedOutlines: CFF outlines are exported without hinting. Imported PostScript hints and TrueType instructions are not retained.
warning.type1LayoutLoss: Type 1 retains static outlines, widths and an 8-bit encoding. OpenType layout, kerning, anchors, other masters and source layers are not retained.
warning.type1HintingLoss: Type 1 output is unhinted. Imported PostScript hints and TrueType instructions are not retained.
warning.type1UnicodeLoss: Type 1 has no Unicode cmap. Some Unicode assignments cannot be recovered from glyph names.
warning.cffHintsNotImported: CFF outlines were imported without per-glyph stem and hint-mask data
warning.glyphNamesSynthesized: Glyph names were synthesized because the font had no usable glyph names.
warning.hintingDropped: All TrueType instructions were dropped from the exported font.
warning.hintingDroppedGlyphSetChanged: TrueType instructions were dropped because the exported glyph set or order changed.
warning.preservationUnavailable: Imported tables could not be preserved because the document has no import provenance.
warning.layoutDropped: Imported layout tables were dropped because the glyph order changed.
warning.rawTableDropped: Imported raw tables were dropped because the glyph order changed.
warning.variationTablesDropped: Imported variation tables were dropped from this static export.
warning.provenanceHashMismatch: Imported tables were not preserved because the source font no longer matches its provenance record.
warning.removeOverlapUnavailable: Overlap removal is not available yet and was not applied.
warning.autohintUnavailable: Automatic hinting is not available yet and was not applied.
warning.productionNamesUnavailable: Type 1 export retains source glyph names. Production names were not applied.
warning.variationSequencesDropped: Unicode variation sequences are not written by this exporter.
warning.postNamesOmitted: The font exceeds the capacity of a named post table, so glyph names were omitted.
warning.invalidHorizontalKerning: Some kerning records could not be compiled. The original data is retained. {{message}}

fontView.noMatches: No glyphs match the current filter.

fontInfo.noNames: This font has no name records.
fontInfo.noAxes: This font has no variation axes.
fontInfo.noTables: This document has no imported table inventory.

banner.recovered: Recovered from {{path}} — saving overwrites the original.

textControls.sizeInvalid: Enter a size from 1 to 512 px

infoBox.label: Info box
infoBox.invalid: Enter a number, or an expression such as +10 or *2
infoBox.name: Name

anchors.hint: Select a row to move the anchor on the canvas.

guides.title: Guides
guides.rulerHint: ⌥-drag from a ruler to place a guide; hold ⇧ for the master.

transform.title: Transform
transform.wholeLayer: Nothing selected — the whole layer is transformed.

kerningCanvas.label: Kerning gap
kerningCanvas.help: Select a gap handle in text mode, or enter glyph names below.
kerningCanvas.rtl: Gap editing is unavailable for right-to-left text. Enter glyph names to edit a pair.
kerningCanvas.cluster: This boundary contains a ligature or combined glyphs. Enter glyph names to edit a pair.
kerningCanvas.named: Slash names are shown individually. Enter the names below to edit their kerning.
kerningCanvas.unresolved: This boundary has a glyph that cannot be matched to the document.

kerningGroups.title: Kerning groups
kerningGroups.selectGlyph: Select a glyph to edit its outline and kerning groups.
kerningGroups.shared: Group membership applies to every master.
kerningGroups.loadFailed: Kerning groups could not be loaded.
kerningGroups.changeFailed: The group change could not be confirmed. Check the stored membership before trying again.
kerningGroups.invalidMembership: Some stored group memberships need correction before they can be edited.

unavailable.imported_layout: This font’s imported spacing rules cannot yet be edited.
unavailable.source_owned_kerning: This font’s kerning is defined in its feature source. Group editing is unavailable.
unavailable.invalid_feature_source: The feature source needs correction before kerning can be edited.

kerningGroups.nameHint: Enter a suffix or a full {{prefix}} group name.
kerningGroups.confirmDelete: Remove {{name}} and clear its {{members}} memberships? This affects every master.
kerningGroups.confirmPairs: Horizontal pair records removed across all masters: {{count}}.

kerningText.title: Kerning
kerningText.valueHint: Zero is an explicit override. Remove the rule to inherit.
kerningText.invalidValue: Enter a finite number of font units.
kerningText.inherited: No record at this scope; showing the resolved pair value.
kerningText.removeHint: Remove the stored rule to use inherited kerning.
kerningText.empty: Select a gap or enter two glyph names.
kerningText.loadFailed: This pair could not be read. Check both glyph names and their groups.
kerningText.impactFailed: The affected group members could not be read. Select the scope again to refresh.
kerningText.imported_layout: The imported font’s spacing rules cannot yet be edited.
kerningText.source_owned_kerning: Kerning is defined by this font’s feature source and cannot be edited here yet.
kerningText.invalid_feature_source: Fix errors in the font’s feature source before editing kerning.

features.title: Features
features.noSelection: Select a source block or add one to begin editing.
features.savedDraft: Draft saved; preview still uses applied source
features.importedHelp: Original lookup tables remain active. Inspect and convert the complete layout before editing its source.
features.loadError: Feature sources could not be loaded.
features.persistenceFailed: Draft could not be saved. Your text is retained here.
features.draftHelp: Drafts are saved with the document, including invalid source. Compile & preview activates valid changes.
features.unappliedExport: Apply or discard the draft before exporting.
features.validationPending: Check source or compile to refresh diagnostics.
features.diagnosticsTruncated: More diagnostics were omitted. Fix the reported issues and check again.
features.generationHelp: Name recipes are opt-in. Compile & preview creates their rules.
features.generationStale: Glyphs changed since the last generation. Compile & preview to regenerate.
features.freezeHelp: Freeze copies the current generated rules and disables that recipe. Compile & preview applies the saved draft.
features.writerAnchors: Generate mark rules from glyph anchors
features.conflict: The saved source changed in another operation. Copy any local text you want to keep, then discard local changes and reload.
features.freezePreview: Compile & preview before freezing newly generated rules.

layoutInspector.title: Original lookups
layoutInspector.originalActive: Preview and export currently use the original layout tables.
layoutInspector.sourceActive: Preview and export use editable source. These are the original rules retained for reference.
layoutInspector.loadFailed: Could not load the original layout.
layoutInspector.rulesFailed: Could not load this lookup’s rules. Refresh to use the current font revision.
layoutInspector.moreBlockers: Additional conversion blockers are not shown.
layoutInspector.noRules: This lookup has no rendered rules.
layoutInspector.ruleTruncated: This rule’s text or initial glyph summary is shortened. Browse its glyph pages below.
layoutInspector.outlineFailed: Could not load this glyph’s outline.

conversion.explanation: Check that editable source reproduces the original layout before converting. Your outlines stay in place.
conversion.preferModelLift: Use pair, group and anchor controls where equivalent
conversion.blocked: Conversion is unavailable for this font. Review the coverage reasons below.
conversion.proven: The conversion passed layout equivalence checks for this font revision.
conversion.kerningLifted: Horizontal kerning can be edited with glyph pairs and groups.
conversion.kerningSource: Any kerning rules remain in feature source.
conversion.anchorsLifted: Supported mark positioning can be edited with glyph anchors.
conversion.anchorsSource: Any mark positioning rules remain in feature source.
conversion.expired: This conversion check has expired. Check conversion again.
conversion.stale: The font or selected master changed. Check conversion again.
conversion.revertExplanation: The original layout is retained in this document and can be restored when its glyph mapping remains compatible.
conversion.revertConfirm: Restore the original layout and the spacing and anchors transferred during conversion? This replaces the current feature source. Outline and font-information edits are kept.

bitmap.title: Bitmap editor
bitmap.rasterHint: Rasterization updates the chosen size and depth. Existing pixels for the selected glyphs are replaced; outlines remain editable.
bitmap.traceHint: Creates exact pixel-edge contours in the selected master. Undo restores the previous outline.
bitmap.empty: Create a strike or rasterize outlines to begin editing.
bitmap.writeFailed: The bitmap could not be saved. Your local pixels are retained. Retry, or discard the local changes to reload.
bitmap.editHint: Drag to draw. The accent line marks the baseline. Resizing preserves baseline coordinates; transforms and paste are clipped to the canvas.
bitmap.waterfallHint: Each row uses its actual strike size, without outline scaling or shaping. Missing characters leave a space.
bitmap.exportHint: Single-strike formats retain bitmap pixels and supported metrics. Keep an FCF copy for other strikes, outlines, layout and editable source data.
bitmap.scaleHint: Nearest-pixel sampling by default. Smoothing uses the strike’s existing depth; origin and advance remain unchanged.
bitmap.clipboardDepth: The copied pixels use a different depth. Select a strike with the same depth to paste.
